title: ResilientDiagnosticRecord
description: Root-cause-first crash/diagnostics record emitted by the resilient loader (RDR). The typed LoaderFault and its stable code are field #1, not buried in prose. Deterministic and diffable: identical faults produce byte-identical cores (modulo timestamps), so N occurrences of a defect collapse to one repro_key bucket. Privacy by projection (I8): the telemetry tier is an allowlist projection of the local record, never a scrub — path-like fields are represented symbolically (store names, hashes), so there is no user path to leak. This is the same fabric discipline as the reasoning-evidence receipts and the twin's reference-gated projection.

process.description: The process that faulted. imageHash is content-addressed (no path).

fault.description: The whole typed fault value — root cause as field #1.

phase.description: Launch state machine phase at fault time.

coreSize.description: Size of the REQUIRED core closure.

sealedManifestHash.description: Hash of the Sealed Closure Manifest (SCM).

redaction.description: Which projection this record is. telemetry = allowlist projection (fault code, interface name, versions, repro_key, os build, model) — PII-free by construction.

reproKey.description: = H(fault.code || import.name || chain || image_hash). EXCLUDES timestamps/addresses/PIDs so identical defects coalesce to one bucket.
